objects.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit / transparent extraction. Take ONLY the capped black and gold fountain pen from this illustration and remove the entire silver metal tray/stand beneath it. Output ONE isolated horizontal pen with genuinely transparent background. Preserve the black torpedo-shaped capped barrel, subtle gold cap bands, gold clip, tiny pale cap-end dot, and the soft hand-painted 2.5D shading. The pen lies flat left-to-right on an imaginary desktop, viewed from slightly above. NO pen stand, no base, no tray, no case, no floor or desktop, no text. Include only a very subtle tight soft contact shadow directly beneath the pen. Make the pen large across 85% of a wide landscape canvas, keep its real slender length-to-thickness ratio (about12:1). It will be placed SMALL (about45px long) on the existing walnut desk.
